worker_model.finding: CLI default shadows unified config; no fallback chain

gaps: auth and not-found errors exhaust retries unnecessarily

failure_modes: network timeout — retried with backoff, acceptable
partial section upload — retried from start, no file-level checkpoint

commit_operation_copy.known_issue: HF hub silently drops CommitOperationCopy ops in bulk commits

silent_drop_risks: batch commit drops 1+ copies without error
script exits 1 on missing files but leaves repo in partial state
no automated retry per dropped file
no cleanup of failed partial publish

destination_validation.current: presence-only — checks file exists on remote after commit
gaps: no sha256 check for copied dataset files
no sha256 check for added metadata/docs files

duplicate_publish_prevention.risk: running twice creates duplicate index entries and may error or overwrite

rollback.proposed: pre-commit snapshot + post-commit verification gate + documented runbook
